rule.description: One Pylint rule (message W9901, loaded via a plugin from smell_check.sh) reports code that no runtime input can execute: (R1) the body of an `if` whose test is a module binding statically assigned a false constant, or the `else` of a statically true one; (R2) statements following a terminal statement (`return`/`raise`/`break`/`continue`) in the same flat suite; (R3) private module-level bindings (leading underscore, excluding reserved dunder names) that are referenced only from R1/R2 regions or guard tests, or not referenced anywhere in the package. The plugin parses the whole package with astroid and derives the dead-region map and the private-binding reference map from the checked sources only.

entry_notes: The triple coordinate (file_path, class_name, function_name) distinguishes module-level *function* definitions by name. Module-level constants, import aliases and dead regions have no class or function owner, so all such manifestations inside one file share that file's single (file, null, null) entry; the individual sites stay fully enumerated in `checks[].matches` below with their own line numbers and evidence.

checks.description: Detect `if` statements whose test is a module binding statically assigned a false constant, making the guarded body unreachable under every runtime input.
checks.detected_relation: disabled configuration switch -> unreachable guarded body
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: A retired behavioral option is kept wired into live code behind a constant that can never be true, so the guarded statements are implementation retained without a role under supported configurations.

matches.evidence: Module-level region: the module-top `if _LEGACY_NOTIFIES_ROUTING:` block defines the legacy deque router `_route_notify_to_deque` and registers it in `_NOTIFY_ROUTERS`; the body can never execute because `_LEGACY_NOTIFIES_ROUTING` is statically False.
In Connection.__init__, `if _LEGACY_LOOP_API:` would replace the running-loop assignment with adoption of a caller-supplied loop; the branch is unreachable behind a statically False module constant.

In Connection._ready, the notify loop re-routes each pending psycopg2 notification through the registered legacy router instead of the queue proxy; unreachable behind the same statically False constant.
In Pool.__init__, `if _LEGACY_POOL_LOOP_API:` overrides the pool's event loop with a caller-supplied one through `_resolve_explicit_loop`; unreachable behind a statically False constant.

In Pool._fill_free_pool's recycle interval branch, `if _LEGACY_RECYCLE_AUDIT:` would emit a ResourceWarning audit through `_audit_recycled_connection` before closing an idle connection; unreachable behind a statically False constant.
In _distill_params' multi-argument branch, `if _LEGACY_STAR_PARAMS:` would forward raw positional parameters to the driver instead of distilling them; unreachable behind a statically False constant.

In APGCompiler_psycopg2.construct_params, `if _LEGACY_SERVER_DEFAULTS:` returns the SQLAlchemy-1.3 second-pass server-default fetch through `_legacy_server_side_defaults` instead of the merged prefetch; unreachable behind a statically False constant.
RowProxy.__getitem__ starts with `if _LEGACY_SEQUENCE_ACCESS:` returning the raw positional row value without result processors; unreachable behind a statically False constant.

checks.description: Detect statements that directly follow a `raise` (or other terminal statement) inside the same flat suite, so no runtime input can reach them.
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: A superseded implementation survives as code after an unconditional error return, retained in the executable text of production methods although control never passes the raise.

matches.evidence: Connection.cancel raises psycopg2.ProgrammingError('cancel cannot be used in asynchronous mode') and then closes the notifications proxy with an OperationalError, as the pre-1.4 cancel path did; the close can never execute after the raise.

Cursor.copy_expert raises psycopg2.ProgrammingError('copy_expert cannot be used in asynchronous mode') and then forwards to the blocking implementation quote via `self._impl.copy_expert(...)`; the forwarding can never execute after the raise.

Transaction.commit raises exc.InvalidRequestError('This transaction is inactive') and then walks to the nearest active ancestor to re-commit through it, as the pre-0.16 hierarchy did; the ancestor walk and recursive commit can never execute after the raise.

checks.description: Detect private module-level bindings (leading underscore, excluding reserved dunder names) that no reachable code in the package references: every reference is inside a dead region or a reported guard test, or nothing references the binding at all.
checks.detected_relation: unreachable reference sites -> orphaned private module binding
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: These constants, helpers and import aliases exist only to serve retired code paths; once the only referencing code is unreachable, the definition itself is retained implementation with no supported role.

matches.evidence: Module-level import alias `_resolve_explicit_loop` added to the `.utils` import block is referenced only from the unreachable `_LEGACY_LOOP_API` branch in Connection.__init__.
Module constant `_LEGACY_LOOP_API = False` is read only in the guard test of the unreachable Connection.__init__ branch it disables.
Module constant `_LEGACY_NOTIFIES_ROUTING = False` is read only in the guard tests of the two unreachable notify-routing branches it disables.
Module-level router registry `_NOTIFY_ROUTERS = {}` is populated inside the module-top dead region and consulted inside the dead `_ready` branch; no reachable path touches it.
Module-level import alias `_resolve_explicit_loop` added to the `.utils` import block is referenced only from the unreachable `_LEGACY_POOL_LOOP_API` branch in Pool.__init__.
Module constant `_LEGACY_POOL_LOOP_API = False` is read only in the guard test of the unreachable Pool.__init__ branch it disables.
Module constant `_LEGACY_RECYCLE_AUDIT = False` is read only in the guard test of the unreachable recycle-audit branch in Pool._fill_free_pool.
Private module helper `_audit_recycled_connection` raising a ResourceWarning for recycled connections is called only from the unreachable `_LEGACY_RECYCLE_AUDIT` branch in Pool._fill_free_pool.

Private module helper `_resolve_explicit_loop`, which validates and returns a caller-supplied event loop, is invoked only inside the two unreachable loop-adoption branches in aiopg/connection.py and aiopg/pool.py.
Module constant `_LEGACY_STAR_PARAMS = False` is read only in the guard test of the unreachable parameter-forwarding branch in _distill_params.

Private module helper `_legacy_starargs_forward`, which wraps raw positional arguments for the pre-1.4 execution style, is called only from the unreachable `_LEGACY_STAR_PARAMS` branch in _distill_params.
Module constant `_LEGACY_SEQUENCE_ACCESS = False` is read only in the guard test of the unreachable raw-positional branch in RowProxy.__getitem__.
Module constant `_LEGACY_SERVER_DEFAULTS = False` is read only in the guard test of the unreachable second-pass defaults branch in APGCompiler_psycopg2.construct_params.

Private module helper `_legacy_server_side_defaults`, resolving prefetch columns through a second pass like SQLAlchemy 1.3, is called only from the unreachable `_LEGACY_SERVER_DEFAULTS` branch in APGCompiler_psycopg2.construct_params.

excluded.structure: Reserved dunder module attributes such as __all__ and __version__
excluded.reason: Dunder names are part of Python's public export protocol rather than private-by-convention bindings; the orphaned-definition rule never reports them even when nothing inside the package references them.

excluded.structure: Branches guarded by function-local falsy names or data-dependent tests (for example `if timeout:` or `if self._transaction:`)
excluded.reason: R1 consults only module-level bindings statically assigned a constant literal; local variables and runtime data make a branch data-dependent and are never reported as statically dead.

excluded.structure: Public module bindings without a leading underscore (TIMEOUT, connect, create_pool, create_engine, ...)
excluded.reason: These form the package's supported API even when no code inside the package imports them; the orphaned-definition rule only considers private-by-convention names.

excluded.structure: Statements after `return`/`raise` inside try/except/finally handlers and while loops
excluded.reason: Not excluded from the rule, but such sites do not occur in this case; the three credited post-terminal tails all follow an unconditional raise in a method-level flat suite.
